mostWorthwhile.text: The practice-panel handoff was most worthwhile: Sal and Miro checked and repaired a real fault, then Miro repeated the check under his own credentials. It showed that shared responsibility requires practiced people, not just a roster.

leastWorthwhile.text: Stocking the cupboard was straightforward and less engaging than diagnosing the panel, though the shared access and mechanical fallback gave it a purpose.

surprise.text: The practice panel had power while reporting a missing signal; a lit lamp did not mean its reporting path worked.

arbitrary.text: I guessed that the cupboard itself would supply the panel repair, but the game required the spares as a separate partner. The feedback made the needed pairing clear.

continue.text: Yes. I would choose another chapter for the combination of practical fault-finding and the story's attention to who can maintain a system after its builder leaves, although some straightforward fitting steps were less engaging.
